story: Ada sends Sam $20 privately with the note "Train tickets". Sam's phone finds it in Kova's public feed with its viewing key, opens the sealed memo (From Ada, the note) itself, and shows +$20 private. Sam pays Ada's Bakery (croissant + flat white, $7.75) straight from that one-time address; the $12.25 change stays there, still private.
api: Local Kova API at commit f33743d (sealed memos, feed from/sealed/announce, ERC-5564 announcer), app at 174e623 + dev stash tooling. The deployed testnet API does not have f33743d yet, so Ada's Bakery here is a copy of adas-bakery-a2cf (same name and menu), not that stall.
device: Kova iPhone 16 simulator, 1179x2556, status bar pinned to 9:41
